messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: P0 - continuous-batcher latency cliff across eu-west-1 (kv-cache pressure) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Summary: sudden latency jump and 5xx spike for /v1/generate during sustained high concurrency (60k rps). Auto-escalated to oncall.
mira: oncall acked, I'm looking. which pools? any customer pages? :eyes:
jun: visible in cb-pool-9 and cb-pool-11. KV cache growth + eviction churn. metric: kvcache.size per inst jumped x12 in 2m.
jun: logs show repeated cache-evict entries like: `evict key=conv-<id> size=12MB reason=aged` every 200ms.
alex: I'm seeing continuous-batcher microbatch window climb to 200ms under load (expected 20-40ms). That increases queueing and leads to large microbatches -> KV spike.
mira: customer impact? sam: two customers (ad-svc-prod, search-qa) report high latency + 502s. ad-svc-prod 7% error rate, search-qa 12% for last 6m.
sam: stack: continuous-batcher v2.4.1 + kvcache-redis-map v1.3.3. We rolled cb v2.4.1 yesterday in eu-west canary.
jun: hypothesis: jitter or batching-policy change in v2.4.1 allowed microbatch growth under bursty in-flight requests; kvcache delayed eviction leads to memory pressure, then aggressive eviction causes churn and stalls RPCs.
alex: can we quickly throttle incoming request admission at the gateway to relieve cb? or force smaller microbatch max size?
mira: priority: 1) stop customer impact, 2) stabilize kvcache, 3) revert risky change or apply targeted config.
ops-bot: Runbook step: apply runtime config patch via /ops/runtime-configs apply --service continuous-batcher --patch-file -
ops-bot: Example config patch accepted: `{"microbatch_max_tokens":256, "microbatch_time_ms":30, "kvcache_max_entries":200000}`
alex: I'm going to push a conservative config: microbatch_time_ms=25, microbatch_max_tokens=192, kvcache_max_entries=150000, enable_backpressure=true. prepping patch now.
jun: while patching, let's enable request dampening: set route-level concurrency cap for embeddings/generation to 8000 per pool. That will reduce queueing.
mira: please post exact command and I'll approve.
alex: running:
```
/ops/runtime-configs apply --service continuous-batcher --region eu-west-1 <<EOF
{
  "microbatch_time_ms": 25,
  "microbatch_max_tokens": 192,
  "enable_backpressure": true,
  "kvcache_max_entries": 150000,
  "batch_jitter_ms": 6
}
EOF
```
alex: patch applied to cb-pool-9 and cb-pool-11, rolling 30s. watch metrics.
jun: watching dashboards: microbatch_time falls to ~28ms, batch sizes drop ~60%. kvcache.avg_entry_size stable, eviction rate down 70%.
sam: error rate dropping: ad-svc-prod from 7% -> 1.2% in 3m, search-qa 12% -> 2.5%. latency p95 back to baseline-ish.
mira: good. who can own short post-incident notes and customer comms? jun can own tech writeup, sam will coordinate customer updates explaining temporary throttles.
jun: noted, will draft tech summary + investigation steps.
alex: follow-up items I see: add a pre-deploy load test that ramps to bursty 60k rps, add circuit breaker for microbatch growth, add metric alert for microbatch_time_ms > 50ms AND kvcache_evictions > 100/s.
mira: create github issues and link to this thread. assign owners. Also schedule a retro with infra and runtime teams.
ops-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation applied and verified. Logging incident in tracker: INC-2026-0842.
incident-bot: Pager resolved. Please file postmortem within 72h.
mira: closing here for now. thanks all for quick sync :heart:
